content.user_title: Review Code for Security and Quality
content.value_statement: Manual reviews can miss security, performance, and test gaps. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through a structured review checklist.
actual_capabilities: Reviews code for security risks such as injection, XSS, hardcoded secrets, and authorization gaps.
Checks performance risks including N+1 queries, expensive renders, memory leaks, and inefficient algorithms.
Evaluates maintainability using complexity, function length, duplication, naming, and documentation signals.
Assesses test coverage quality, missing edge cases, flaky tests, and critical path coverage.
Prioritizes review feedback by severity with concrete improvement suggestions.
Provides checklists and review comment formats for consistent team feedback.
limitations: It does not execute tests unless the host agent has shell tools and user approval.
It cannot prove runtime behavior without enough project context and relevant files.
It may miss framework-specific issues not visible in the reviewed code.
It supports human review but does not replace a dedicated security audit.

use_cases.title: Review an API Change
use_cases.description: Find security, validation, performance, and test coverage issues before a backend merge.

use_cases.title: Check a Frontend Update
use_cases.description: Assess React rendering costs, XSS risks, component complexity, and missing UI tests.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Merge Review
use_cases.description: Organize findings by priority and produce clear review comments for a pull request.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Small Change
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a focused change
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the selected files for bugs, security concerns, and simple maintainability issues. Prioritize findings that should block a merge.

prompt_templates.title: Check Security and Tests
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review for risky application logic
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this change for input validation, authorization, secret handling, and missing tests. Include concrete fixes for each important issue.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Performance and Maintainability
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of a larger feature
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the changed code for slow operations, repeated work, complex functions, duplication, and unclear boundaries. Group findings by severity.

prompt_templates.title: Perform Release Gate Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Perform a release readiness review across security, performance, maintainability, tests, and documentation. Identify blockers, risks, and follow-up tasks.

output_examples.input: Review an authentication change before merge.
output: High: The password reset path lacks rate limiting and should be protected before release.
Medium: Add tests for expired tokens and repeated reset attempts.
Low: Clarify the error message so users know the next step.

output_examples.input: Review a React list rendering update.
output: Medium: The component recomputes filtered results on every render. Cache the derived list when inputs do not change.
Medium: Add a test for an empty result set and loading state.
Low: Extract the item label formatting to reduce component complexity.
High: Confirm the new query preserves tenant filtering before merge.
Medium: Add coverage for missing records and permission denied responses.
Low: Document why the join order was changed.

best_practices: Provide the relevant diff, affected files, and project context before asking for review.
Ask for severity-ranked findings when the review may affect a merge decision.
Verify important recommendations with tests, local checks, or a human reviewer.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a broad review without providing the changed files or target risk areas.
Do not treat every suggestion as a blocker without judging impact and likelihood.
Do not run project commands from untrusted code without approval and isolation.

faq.question: What does this skill review?
faq.answer: It reviews security, performance, maintainability, test coverage, documentation, and code smell risks.

faq.question: Does it run tests automatically?
faq.answer: No. It can suggest test commands, but execution depends on the host agent tools and user approval.

faq.question: Can it replace a human reviewer?
faq.answer: No. It helps find common issues and organize feedback, but humans should verify important decisions.

faq.question: Which assistants can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is it useful for security review?
faq.answer: Yes. It checks common risks such as injection, XSS, secret handling, authorization, and sensitive data exposure.

faq.question: What input works best?
faq.answer: Provide the diff, related files, test results if available, and the main concerns for the review.
